question: If mabeasts will follow a person who breaks their horn, then exactly what Roswaal was saying earlier, repeatedly having a broken-horned mabeast break the horn of another mabeast, wouldn’t it be fairly easy to wipe out the mabeasts? Did this method not catch on?
answer: Mabeasts with broken horns are rapidly lynched by mabeasts with horns. “Hey, isn’t that one different from us? Should we get him?”, then they get surrounded and beat.
